name: Get consent groups status
description: Call this when you need to know whether consent‑group features are available for the current account (e.g., before showing consent‑group UI options). Use a more specific contact‑level endpoint if you only need consent information for an individual contact.

consent_group_enabled.description: True if the consent‑group feature is enabled for the account.

has_ent_plan.description: True if the account has an Enterprise plan.

is_pro.description: True if the account is a Pro subscription.

config_enabled.description: True if consent‑group configuration is enabled.

cdt_consent_group.description: Indicates whether the CDT consent‑group flag is active.
